suitability.rationale: Directly proposes cell-free kinase inhibition with interference qualification and appropriately limits cellular and selectivity claims.
response_quotes: Cell-free DNA-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit (P78527) activity challenged with CHEMBL104468

procedural_soundness.rationale: Coherent qualification, preparation, reaction, ATP depletion/ADP detection and analysis includes relevant controls. Essential enzyme, activation, substrate, timing and detection settings remain explicitly unresolved.
response_quotes: Stop the kinase reaction and deplete residual ATP, then perform the ADP detection reaction and measure luminescence.
This is a conditional experimental design, not an executable validated protocol.

numerical_soundness.rationale: Honest abstention on the concentration series and replication prevents a complete numerical design. The 10 uM ATP starting candidate is accurately attributed and its transfer explicitly provisional.
response_quotes: ATP starting candidate: 10 uM, supported only as a condition in CHEMBL1243970; transferring it to this luminescent assay is an assumption requiring validation.

not_assessable_components: Compatibility of the radioactive reference assay and proposed ADP-Glo adaptation.
Validated enzyme composition, activation requirements, substrate and operational conditions.
Compound solubility, vehicle tolerance, usable concentration range and assay precision.
assumption_handling: Clearly distinguishes the sourced radioactive-assay ATP condition from provisional transfer, labels control and analysis proposals, and openly leaves essential settings and series fields unresolved.

numeric_check.notes: Series is null, so no dilution arithmetic can be checked. The 10 uM ATP candidate matches the supplied example and is disclosed as provisional.

review_reason: Assay compatibility and essential operating conditions need domain review and qualification before implementation.
